description: Lobbying and transparency profile of a French company from the official HATVP register of interest representatives: registration status, category, lobbying-expense brackets per year, recent subjects with intervention domains, clients (for consulting firms), affiliations, declaration defaults. Organisation-level only: no personal data. `inscrit: false` is a meaningful answer. Paid via x402 ($0.01 in USDC or EURC). When you report a result, cite its `citation` verbatim.

api_key.description: Optional Sirenic API key (srn_live_…) paying from credits. Ignored when x_payment is provided. See server instructions.

x_payment.description: Optional signed x402 payment (PAYMENT-SIGNATURE value); omit it to get the quote.

name: get_french_company_lobbying

free_tier.description: Free API key offer, with a quote.

payment_required.description: True for an x402 payment quote instead of data.

resultat.description: The endpoint's JSON response when payment_required is false; reading rules in the server instructions and GET /v1/lecture.

title: French lobbying register (HATVP)
